Results show that the effectiveness of both methods depends strongly on dataset characteristics: on large corpora with low noise levels, filtering does not improve performance, while on small datasets with high noise, Confident Learning achieves a significant F1-macro improvement. Dataset Cartography demonstrates more conservative behavior, removing fewer examples. Across all corpora, targeted removal by both methods outperforms random removal, confirming the meaningfulness of the approaches.
papers.title_zh: 训练语言模型的数据过滤方法
papers.abstract_zh: 数据质量是机器学习模型有效性的关键因素。即使在广泛使用的基准测试中也存在标签错误，它会将噪声引入训练数据并降低模型泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们对两种自动标签错误检测方法（置信学习和数据集制图）对不同大小、类别数量和领域的三个俄语文本分类语料库进行了比较分析：ru_emotion_e-culture（49,123 个示例，情感分类）、RuCoLA（8,524 个示例，语言可接受性）和 TERRa（2,337 个示例，文本蕴涵识别）。我们使用在每个语料库上进行微调的预先训练的 rubert-base-cased 模型。为了验证过滤的意义，我们进行了随机删除同等数量示例的控制实验。结果表明，两种方法的有效性在很大程度上取决于数据集特征：在低噪声水平的大型语料库上，过滤不会提高性能，而在高噪声的小数据集上，Confident Learning 实现了显着的 F1 宏观改进。数据集制图展示了更保守的行为，删除了更少的示例。在所有语料库中，两种方法的针对性删除都优于随机删除，证实了这些方法的意义。

papers.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
papers.abstract: Modern open-world agents such as OpenClaw exhibit powerful cross-environment execution capabilities yet introduce broad new safety risk sources. Meanwhile, advanced frontier AI models drastically lower attack barriers, rendering current agent alignment frameworks inadequate for real-world deployment. To tackle these emerging threats, we propose a lightweight and scalable agent safety alignment framework. Specifically, we update the agent safety taxonomy to accommodate emergent risks from Codex and OpenClaw execution scenarios. We further build a taxonomy-guided data engine with influence-function purification to train lightweight AgentDoG 1.5 variants (0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters) using only around 1k samples, achieving comparable performance with leading closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5.4). Based on AgentDoG 1.5, we construct a highly efficient agentic safety SFT and RL training environment, which reduces deployment overhead in Docker-level environments by two orders of magnitude. Finally, we deploy AgentDoG 1.5 as a training-free online guardrail for real-time safety moderation. Extensive experimental results indicate that AgentDoG 1.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in diverse and complex interactive agentic scenarios. All models and datasets are openly released.
papers.title_zh: AgentDoG 1.5：用于 AI 代理安全的轻量级、可扩展的对齐框架
papers.abstract_zh: OpenClaw 等现代开放世界代理展现了强大的跨环境执行能力，但引入了广泛的新安全风险源。与此同时，先进的前沿人工智能模型大大降低了攻击障碍，使当前的代理对齐框架不足以满足现实世界的部署。为了应对这些新出现的威胁，我们提出了一个轻量级且可扩展的代理安全调整框架。具体来说，我们更新了代理安全分类法，以适应 Codex 和 OpenClaw 执行场景中出现的紧急风险。我们进一步构建了一个具有影响函数纯化的分类引导数据引擎，仅使用大约 1k 个样本来训练轻量级 AgentDoG 1.5 变体（0.8B、2B、4B 和 8B 参数），实现了与领先的闭源模型（例如 GPT-5.4）相当的性能。基于AgentDoG 1.5，我们构建了高效的代理安全SFT和RL训练环境，将Docker级环境中的部署开销降低了两个数量级。最后，我们部署 AgentDoG 1.5 作为无需培训的在线护栏，用于实时安全审核。大量的实验结果表明，AgentDoG 1.5 在多样化、复杂的交互代理场景中实现了最先进的性能。所有模型和数据集均公开发布。

papers.title: Low-Magnification SEM May Suffice: Interpretable Deep Learning for Multi-Scale Fracture-Cause Classification in Zirconia-Toughened Alumina
papers.abstract: Reliable identification of fracture origins in alumina matrix composite hip and knee implants is critical for quality assurance and patient safety, yet current fractographic workflows are time-consuming, partly subjective, and reliant on high-magnification scanning electron microscopy (SEM). We present an interpretable vision-transformer (ViT) workflow for automated classification of fracture causes in an alumina matrix composite (BIOLOX delta, CeramTec GmbH) widely used in total joint replacements. A dataset of 8,493 SEM images (50x-10,000x) was curated from five years of in-production burst and proof tests and annotated into three defect categories defined along the manufacturing chain: green body, hard machining, and material defects. Under severe class imbalance, the fine-tuned ViT reached an accuracy of 0.907 and a macro-F1 of 0.888 in stratified five-fold cross-validation, with a two-stage perceptual-hash/SSIM leakage audit confirming negligible specimen overlap. Notably, performance at low magnification (50x) was comparable to that at high magnification (1k-10kx), indicating that macro-scale features - mirror geometry and hackle line fields - already encode sufficient diagnostic signal. Grad-CAM attributions consistently localised on canonical fractographic cues (mirrors, hackles, pores, machining marks), aligning with established fractographic criteria. Together, these results position interpretable ViTs as a complementary tool for ceramic-implant quality assurance, enabling low-magnification pre-screening and reducing reliance on time-intensive high-magnification inspection.
papers.title_zh: 低倍率 SEM 可能就足够了：可解释的深度学习用于氧化锆增韧氧化铝的多尺度断裂原因分类
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠地识别氧化铝基质复合髋关节和膝关节植入物中的骨折起源对于质量保证和患者安全至关重要，但目前的断口工作流程非常耗时，部分主观，并且依赖于高倍扫描电子显微镜 (SEM)。我们提出了一种可解释的视觉变换器 (ViT) 工作流程，用于对广泛用于全关节置换的氧化铝基复合材料（BIOLOX delta，CeramTec GmbH）的断裂原因进行自动分类。 8,493 张 SEM 图像 (50x-10,000x) 的数据集是根据五年的生产爆破和验证测试整理而成的，并注释为沿制造链定义的三个缺陷类别：生坯、硬加工和材料缺陷。在严重的类别不平衡的情况下，经过微调的 ViT 在分层五重交叉验证中达到了 0.907 的准确度和 0.888 的宏观 F1，并且两阶段感知哈希/SSIM 泄漏审计确认了可忽略的样本重叠。值得注意的是，低放大倍率 (50x) 下的性能与高放大倍率 (1k-10kx) 下的性能相当，这表明宏观尺度特征（镜子几何结构和锯齿线场）已经编码了足够的诊断信号。 Grad-CAM 归因始终定位于规范的断口线索（镜子、锯齿、孔隙、加工痕迹），与既定的断口标准保持一致。总之，这些结果使可解释的 ViT 成为陶瓷种植体质量保证的补充工具，实现低放大倍数预筛选并减少对耗时的高放大倍数检查的依赖。

papers.title: SAAS: Self-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Over-Search Mitigation in Agentic Search
papers.abstract: Agentic search enables LLMs to solve complex multi-hop questions through iterative reasoning and external search. Despite the effectiveness, these systems often suffer from a critical limitation in practice: agents fail to recognize their own knowledge boundaries, blindly triggering searches when internal knowledge suffices and failing to terminate search even when adequate evidence has been collected. The lack of self-awareness leads to severe \textbf{over-search}, incurring substantial inference latency and prohibitive computational cost. To this end, we propose SAAS, a novel RL framework designed to cultivate dynamic self-awareness that precisely regulates search behavior without compromising accuracy. SAAS introduces three key components: (i) a search boundary modeling mechanism, which identifies the search boundary under the evolving policy by contrasting search-disabled and search-enabled rollouts; (ii) a boundary-aware reward module, which translates this boundary awareness into trajectory-level penalties, suppressing unnecessary and redundant searches; and (iii) a stage-wise optimization strategy, which leverages a sequential curriculum to prioritize reasoning over search regularization, thereby avoiding reward hacking. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAAS substantially reduces over-search, while maintaining accuracy. Our code is anonymously released at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/SAAS.
papers.title_zh: SAAS：用于缓解代理搜索中过度搜索的自我意识强化学习
papers.abstract_zh: 代理搜索使法学硕士能够通过迭代推理和外部搜索来解决复杂的多跳问题。尽管有效，但这些系统在实践中常常受到严重限制：智能体无法识别自己的知识边界，在内部知识足够的情况下盲目触发搜索，即使收集到足够的证据也无法终止搜索。缺乏自我意识会导致严重的\textbf{过度搜索}，导致大量的推理延迟和高昂的计算成本。为此，我们提出了 SAAS，这是一种新颖的 RL 框架，旨在培养动态自我意识，精确调节搜索行为而不影响准确性。 SAAS 引入了三个关键组件：(i) 搜索边界建模机制，通过对比禁用搜索和启用搜索的部署来识别不断发展的策略下的搜索边界； (ii) 边界感知奖励模块，将边界感知转化为轨迹级惩罚，抑制不必要和冗余的搜索； (iii) 分阶段优化策略，利用顺序课程将推理优先于搜索正则化，从而避免奖励黑客攻击。大量实验表明，SAAS 大大减少了过度搜索，同时保持了准确性。我们的代码在 https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/SAAS 上匿名发布。

papers.title: SkillsInjector: Dynamic Skill Context Construction for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents now draw on growing skill libraries to handle complex tasks. However, injecting more skills does not always improve task completion and can even degrade it. Existing methods still treat skill injection as a static step, selecting skills with fixed criteria, fixing the budget in advance, and leaving descriptions unchanged. We argue that this static treatment can undermine the utility of skills, because which skills are exposed, how many are included, and how they are presented all affect downstream performance. We propose SkillsInjector, a two-stage adaptive method that jointly addresses these decisions. First, a context planner learns execution-grounded skill preferences and admits an adaptive number of skills for each task. A set-aware renderer then tailors how selected descriptions are presented relative to their co-injected neighbors. Across tau2-bench, SkillsBench, and ALFWorld, SkillsInjector achieves the highest score, improving over the strongest baseline by 3.9, 6.1, and 7.3 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies show that skill selection, adaptive budgeting, and set-aware rendering each contribute to the gain. These results show that skill-augmented agents benefit from optimizing the injected context itself. Code will be released upon publication
papers.title_zh: SkillsInjector：LLM 代理的动态技能上下文构建
papers.abstract_zh: LLM 代理现在利用不断增长的技能库来处理复杂的任务。然而，注入更多的技能并不总能提高任务的完成度，甚至可能会降低任务的完成度。现有的方法仍然将技能注入视为静态步骤，以固定标准选择技能，提前确定预算，并保持描述不变。我们认为，这种静态处理可能会破坏技能的效用，因为暴露哪些技能、包含多少技能以及它们的呈现方式都会影响下游绩效。我们提出了 SkillsInjector，这是一种两阶段自适应方法，可以共同解决这些决策。首先，情境规划者学习基于执行的技能偏好，并为每项任务承认适当数量的技能。然后，设置感知渲染器会调整所选描述相对于其共同注入的邻居的呈现方式。在 tau2-bench、SkillsBench 和 ALFWorld 中，SkillsInjector 获得了最高分，比最强基线分别提高了 3.9、6.1 和 7.3 个百分点。消融研究表明，技能选择、自适应预算和设置感知渲染都有助于收益。这些结果表明，技能增强的代理受益于优化注入上下文本身。代码将在发布后发布

papers.title: MEMENTO: Leveraging Web as a Learning Signal for Low-Data Domains
papers.abstract: Real-world tasks often lack large labeled datasets, motivating extensive work on learning in low-data regimes. However, existing approaches such as few-shot prompting, instruction tuning, and synthetic data generation, continue to treat labeled or pseudo-labeled data as the primary learning signal. In contrast, human practitioners acquire expertise through repeated, self-directed interaction with the open web, progressively refining both domain knowledge and search strategies. We propose MEMENTO, a framework that treats the web as a learning signal rather than a stateless retrieval interface. MEMENTO operates at two levels: within each session, it conducts iterative web exploration via an Adaptive Exploration Tree (AET) that decomposes tasks into evolving questions and reflects on intermediate findings; across sessions, it accumulates experience through dual-channel memory, separating declarative knowledge (facts) from procedural knowledge (search strategies). This design enables agents to learn reusable research strategies and domain expertise from trajectories of web interaction without additional model training. We evaluate MEMENTO on two low-data professional domains: sales automation and legal research. Our empirical results show consistent improvements in performance over ReAct based baselines (+25.6% on sales automation and 36.5% on legal research), demonstrating that the web can serve as a scalable learning source for acquiring task-specific expertise in data-scarce settings.
papers.title_zh: 纪念品：利用网络作为低数据领域的学习信号
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界的任务通常缺乏大型标记数据集，从而激发了在低数据状态下进行大量学习工作。然而，现有的方法，例如少样本提示、指令调整和合成数据生成，继续将标记或伪标记数据视为主要学习信号。相比之下，人类从业者通过与开放网络重复、自我引导的交互来获取专业知识，逐步完善领域知识和搜索策略。我们提出了 MMENTO，一个将网络视为学习信号而不是无状态检索界面的框架。 MMENTO 在两个层面上运行：在每个会话中，它通过自适应探索树 (AET) 进行迭代网络探索，将任务分解为不断发展的问题并反映中间结果；在各个会话中，它通过双通道记忆积累经验，将陈述性知识（事实）与程序性知识（搜索策略）分开。这种设计使智能体能够从网络交互的轨迹中学习可重用的研究策略和领域专业知识，而无需额外的模型训练。我们在两个低数据专业领域评估 MMENTO：销售自动化和法律研究。我们的实证结果显示，与基于 ReAct 的基线相比，性能持续提高（销售自动化提高 25.6%，法律研究提高 36.5%），这表明网络可以作为可扩展的学习源，用于在数据稀缺的环境中获取特定于任务的专业知识。

papers.title: Fewer Steps, Better Performance: Efficient Cross-Modal Clip Trimming for Video Moment Retrieval Using Language
papers.abstract: Given an untrimmed video and a sentence query, video moment retrieval using language (VMR) aims to locate a target query-relevant moment. Since the untrimmed video is overlong, almost all existing VMR methods first sparsely down-sample each untrimmed video into multiple fixed-length video clips and then conduct multi-modal interactions with the query feature and expensive clip features for reasoning, which is infeasible for long real-world videos that span hours. Since the video is downsampled into fixed-length clips, some query-related frames may be filtered out, which will blur the specific boundary of the target moment, take the adjacent irrelevant frames as new boundaries, easily leading to cross-modal misalignment and introducing both boundary-bias and reasoning-bias. To this end, in this paper, we propose an efficient approach, SpotVMR, to trim the query-relevant clip. Besides, our proposed SpotVMR can serve as plug-and-play module, which achieves efficiency for state-of-the-art VMR methods while maintaining good retrieval performance. Especially, we first design a novel clip search model that learns to identify promising video regions to search conditioned on the language query. Then, we introduce a set of low-cost semantic indexing features to capture the context of objects and interactions that suggest where to search the query-relevant moment. Also, the distillation loss is utilized to address the optimization issues arising from end-to-end joint training of the clip selector and VMR model. Extensive experiments on three challenging datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.
papers.title_zh: 步骤更少，性能更好：使用语言进行视频时刻检索的高效跨模式剪辑修剪
papers.abstract_zh: 给定未修剪的视频和句子查询，使用语言的视频时刻检索（VMR）旨在定位与目标查询相关的时刻。由于未修剪的视频过长，几乎所有现有的VMR方法首先将每个未修剪的视频稀疏下采样为多个固定长度的视频片段，然后与查询特征和昂贵的片段特征进行多模态交互以进行推理，这对于跨越数小时的长现实世界视频是不可行的。由于视频被下采样为固定长度的剪辑，一些与查询相关的帧可能会被过滤掉，这会模糊目标时刻的特定边界，将相邻的不相关帧作为新的边界，容易导致跨模态错位，并引入边界偏差和推理偏差。为此，在本文中，我们提出了一种有效的方法 SpotVMR 来修剪与查询相关的剪辑。此外，我们提出的 SpotVMR 可以作为即插即用模块，在保持良好检索性能的同时实现最先进的 VMR 方法的效率。特别是，我们首先设计了一种新颖的剪辑搜索模型，该模型学习识别有希望的视频区域，以根据语言查询进行搜索。然后，我们引入一组低成本语义索引功能来捕获对象和交互的上下文，以建议在哪里搜索与查询相关的时刻。此外，蒸馏损失还用于解决剪辑选择器和VMR模型的端到端联合训练所产生的优化问题。对三个具有挑战性的数据集的广泛实验证明了其有效性。

papers.title: Evolve as a Team: Collaborative Self-Evolution for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as an effective paradigm for complex and long-horizon tasks. However, in real-world tasks, MAS often exhibit various failures during execution and such failures are difficult to eliminate during design. This motivates experience-driven MAS evolution, where a system improves based on its own execution experience. Yet such evolution is challenging because MAS experience is prolonged and intricate, interleaving multiple agents' execution chains and communication messages, which makes it difficult to identify what should be improved. To address this challenge, we propose Meta-Team, an experience-driven MAS evolution framework based on collaborative self-evolution. Meta-Team preserves the execution context of each agent and coordinates post-task communication, enabling agents to exchange distributed evidence for evolution. Building on this design, Meta-Team conducts multi-scale self-evolution, transforming execution experience into reusable improvements to agent behaviors, inter-agent coordination, and team-level organization. Across six long-horizon agent benchmarks, Meta-Team consistently outperforms single-agent systems, hand-crafted MAS, and prior MAS evolution methods; further analyses demonstrate that Meta-Team enables more reliable and scalable MAS self-evolution.
papers.title_zh: 团队进化：基于 LLM 的多智能体系统的协作自我进化
papers.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统 (MAS) 已成为复杂和长期任务的有效范例。然而，在现实任务中，MAS在执行过程中经常会出现各种故障，并且这些故障在设计过程中很难消除。这激发了经验驱动的 MAS 进化，系统根据自己的执行经验进行改进。然而，这种演变具有挑战性，因为 MAS 的经验是长期且复杂的，多个代理的执行链和通信消息交织在一起，这使得很难确定应该改进的内容。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 Meta-Team，一种基于协作自我进化的经验驱动的 MAS 进化框架。 Meta-Team 保留每个代理的执行上下文并协调任务后通信，使代理能够交换分布式证据以实现进化。在此设计的基础上，Meta-Team 进行多尺度的自我进化，将执行经验转化为对代理行为、代理间协调和团队级别组织的可重用改进。在六个长期代理基准测试中，Meta-Team 始终优于单代理系统、手工制作的 MAS 和先前的 MAS 进化方法；进一步的分析表明，Meta-Team 能够实现更可靠和可扩展的 MAS 自我进化。
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

papers.title: Certified Policy Optimisation for Nested Causal Bandits via PAC-Bayes Risk
papers.abstract: Critical sequential decisions are rarely single-timescale: a strategic decision causally shapes the context in which every subsequent tactical choice is made; standard bandit and reinforcement-learning theory does not capture this causal coupling between timescales. We formalise the problem class as Nested Contextual Causal Bandits (NCCBs), a hierarchical SCM where each level's action sets the next level's context distribution, and propose Nested Causal Thompson Sampling (NCTS), which draws one mechanism-factorised belief per episode and acts recursively under it. Our main theoretical result is a causal PAC-Bayesian excess-risk bound that certifies any candidate deployment policy from historic data alone, off-policy and anytime, answering the deployment question: can we trust this agent here, and at what risk? Experiments on a hierarchical SCM show that, against a matched RFF-GP joint regression on the same function class, the factorised SCM-mechanism posterior transfers significantly better zero-shot under exogenous distribution shifts, the recursive meta-to-inner commit significantly dominates the joint-commit alternative in distribution, and the certificate significantly contracts as offline data accumulates. Combining these results, we establish progressive certified handover, a safe-deployment method: each timescale flips from a legacy controller to NCTS when gains can be certified, independently of the others.
papers.title_zh: 通过 PAC-Bayes Risk 进行嵌套因果强盗的认证策略优化
papers.abstract_zh: 关键的顺序决策很少是单一时间尺度的：战略决策因果性地塑造了每个后续战术选择的背景；标准老虎机和强化学习理论没有捕捉到时间尺度之间的这种因果耦合。我们将问题类形式化为嵌套上下文因果强盗（NCCB），这是一种分层的 SCM，其中每个级别的操作设置下一个级别的上下文分布，并提出嵌套因果汤普森采样（NCTS），它为每个情节绘制一个机制分解的信念并在其下递归操作。我们的主要理论结果是一个因果 PAC-贝叶斯超额风险界限，它可以证明任何候选部署策略仅来自历史数据、非策略且随时，回答了部署问题：我们可以信任这个代理吗？有什么风险？分层 SCM 上的实验表明，相对于同一函数类上匹配的 RFF-GP 联合回归，因式分解的 SCM 机制后验传输在外生分布变化下的零样本传输明显更好，递归元到内部提交在分布中显着主导联合提交替代方案，并且随着离线数据的积累，证书显着收缩。结合这些结果，我们建立了渐进式认证切换，这是一种安全部署方法：当增益可以独立于其他时间进行认证时，每个时间尺度都会从传统控制器翻转到 NCTS。

papers.title: Croissant Tasks: A Metadata Format for Reproducible Machine Learning Evaluations
papers.abstract: Reproducibility is fundamental to the scientific method, yet remains a critical challenge in machine learning. Contributing factors include underspecified execution details and brittle software environments. Human-centric remedies, such as checklists and manual verification, help but require intensive effort and fail to scale. To address this, we introduce Croissant Tasks: a declarative, machine-actionable metadata format that abstracts low-level implementation details into high-level specifications. This format enables conceptual reproducibility: verifying claims via independent, agent-generated implementations rather than brittle source code replication. We contribute: (1) the Croissant Tasks specification, formally decoupling task problem from solution; (2) an automated LLM pipeline that retrofits existing benchmarks into this format; and (3) empirical validation showing autonomous agents can ingest these specifications to generate functional, accurate reproduction pipelines from scratch. We envision this format as a new foundation for automated and conceptual reproducibility in machine learning.
papers.title_zh: Croissant 任务：用于可重复机器学习评估的元数据格式
papers.abstract_zh: 可重复性是科学方法的基础，但仍然是机器学习中的一个关键挑战。影响因素包括未指定的执行细节和脆弱的软件环境。以人为本的补救措施，例如检查表和手动验证，虽然有帮助，但需要付出大量努力，并且无法扩展。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Croissant 任务：一种声明性的、机器可操作的元数据格式，它将低级实现细节抽象为高级规范。这种格式实现了概念上的可重复性：通过独立的、代理生成的实现而不是脆弱的源代码复制来验证声明。我们贡献：（1）Croissant Tasks 规范，正式将任务问题与解决方案解耦； (2) 将现有基准改造为这种格式的自动化 LLM 管道； (3) 经验验证表明，自主代理可以吸收这些规范，从头开始生成功能性的、准确的复制管道。我们设想这种格式作为机器学习中自动化和概念再现性的新基础。
